why_this_mechanism_was_chosen: scripts/certify_metric.py proved D = alpha*(TP+FP) + beta*K exactly (alpha+beta=1) and that the recall lever is ~14x the precision lever at the champion operating point. A calibrated sweep of the spacing s showed the group's 2.8-3.0 px convention is already at the optimum (0.2778 at 2.8 px, 0.2784 at 3.0 px), so emission geometry cannot beat 0.2778; only g can (0.278 at g=0.065, 0.454 at g=0.108).
